scenarios.theme: A teacher moves office, but half the enrollment rows retain the old address. What will you normalize?
scenarios.assumptions: An enrollment export is also the write model. An instructor’s office appears on every enrollment, and partial updates have produced contradictory values. One current office per instructor is the agreed rule. What will you do?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.
